entities.summary: Muhammad Attamimi Halilintar, professionally known as Atta Halilintar, is an Indonesian YouTuber, content creator, social media personality, actor, singer and businessman. He is the first YouTuber in Southeast Asia to earn the Diamond Play Button. He is currently regarded as the most popular YouTuber in Indonesia and hails from the popular Gen Halilintar family, which is known for recording songs and publications. As of December 2021, he has approximately 28.3 million subscribers and is currently ranked as the 301st most subscribed YouTube channel as of 2026.
